message: Retinol with an AHA can cause redness, peeling and irritation.
Retinol with a BHA can over exfoliate and dry out the skin.
Both are active ingredients and may irritate together. Use Vitamin C in the morning and Retinol at night.
Benzoyl Peroxide can break down Retinol and cause dryness.
Two strong actives together can sting. Use them at different times of the day.
Benzoyl Peroxide can oxidise Vitamin C and make it less effective.
Combining two exfoliating acids can damage the skin barrier.
Both dry the skin. Use one at a time if your skin is sensitive.
